evidence: Build brief that classes each step as AGENT, AGENT_HITL, HUMAN_JUDGMENT or HUMAN_CONTROL
must_show: every step has a class and the control screen names the worker-data limits

evidence: Recomputed tier with a named line-1 owner
must_show: the tier is recomputed from the form questions and not copied from the sponsor

evidence: READY or HOLD against the evidence owed at the tier
must_show: each missing item is listed by id

evidence: Vendor rating with exit readiness
must_show: the rating states criticality, data access and the upstream provider

evidence: Board status with reasons computed from evidence
must_show: the reasons cite evidence and not the owner's color

evidence: Capacity row for the review team the program needs
must_show: planned demand is set against supply for the quarter

evidence: Benefit baseline with a named finance partner
must_show: the baseline period and the holdout are stated

evidence: Tool inventory with one least-privilege credential and one owner per tool
must_show: each tool maps to one credential and one owner

evidence: Eval results from a clean checkout with the probe-set version
must_show: the probe-set version and the failing cases are listed

evidence: Validation with effective challenge by a person other than the builder
must_show: the challenge points and how each was resolved

evidence: Agreement with people on the shadow run, with the known-miss list
must_show: each known miss has an owner

evidence: Routing rules and review floors for the cases that go to a person
must_show: the floors and the escalation path are written down

evidence: Weekly report against the exit criteria
must_show: scope violations and unapproved resubmits are counted, including a count of zero

evidence: What is logged per decision, from prompt version to reviewer and outcome
must_show: the log fields cover the decision from input to outcome

evidence: Hand-off signed by the owning team lead, naming the brief version
must_show: the signer is on the owning team and the brief version is named

evidence: Kill switch and rollback to human-only rehearsed by someone other than the builder
must_show: both steps were run and left an audit trace

evidence: Plan for returning the work to people and for leaving the vendor
must_show: the trip conditions and a named approver for restoring

evidence: Queue depth, tool errors, scope blocks and kill-switch state alert on-call
must_show: each listed signal alerts into platform monitoring

evidence: Scheduled drift and run-health report
must_show: the latest report ends in a named decision and not only charts

evidence: Grants set against calls in the window
must_show: grants with no call are listed with an owner decision

evidence: Notification hours confirmed with counsel and a named determination role
must_show: the hours are dated and the determination role is a person

evidence: Widen, fix, hold or retire decision with the evidence it rested on
must_show: the decision is one of the four and cites evidence

evidence: Benefit against a holdout with a hard-cash column
must_show: hard cash and soft capacity are shown apart
